body.statement:
For every \(\ell\geq3\), the graph \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\) in \(\mathrm{def:two\mbox{-}parent\mbox{-}windmill}\) is generically infinite-to-one.  More precisely,
\[
 |D|+|B|-\binom{2\ell}{2}=2\ell-3>0.
\]
Consequently \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\notin\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(2\ell)\), and no collection of rational formulas or graph-ideal certificates can identify every coordinate of \(\theta_{W_{\ell}^{(2)}}\).  Thus the requested outside-auxiliary-cutset windmill conclusion is false, independently of the values of its three graphical certification predicates.
body.proof_tex:
The two directed lists in the construction are disjoint and have cardinalities \(2\ell-1\) and \(2\ell-2\).  Hence
\[
 |D|=(2\ell-1)+(2\ell-2)=4\ell-3. \tag{6}
\]
The first missing-bidirected cycle has \(\ell-1\) consecutive pairs and one closing pair; the second has the same count.  Their edge sets are disjoint for \(\ell\geq3\), so exactly \(2\ell\) of the \(\binom{2\ell}{2}\) possible bidirected edges are missing.  Therefore
\[
 |B|=\binom{2\ell}{2}-2\ell=2\ell^2-3\ell. \tag{7}
\]
Combining (6)--(7),
\[
 |D|+|B|-\binom{2\ell}{2}
 =4\ell-3-2\ell=2\ell-3>0. \tag{8}
\]
The edge-count nonidentifiability criterion applied to (8) makes \(\phi_{W_{\ell}^{(2)}}\) generically infinite-to-one.  Equivalently, including the \(2\ell\) diagonal disturbance variances, the source dimension is
\[
 (4\ell-3)+(2\ell^2-3\ell)+2\ell=2\ell^2+3\ell-3,
\]
whereas there are only \(\ell(2\ell+1)=2\ell^2+\ell\) observed covariance coordinates; the excess is again \(2\ell-3\).  If every source coordinate had a rational formula in the covariance coordinates, then the source function field would be generated by at most \(2\ell^2+\ell\) elements while having transcendence degree \(2\ell^2+3\ell-3\), contradicting (8).  Hence at least one source coordinate lacks any rational identifying certificate.  Generic birationality, and therefore membership in \(\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(2\ell)\), fails.  Since this refutes a necessary conjunct of the question, criterion-failure transcripts cannot restore the requested conclusion.
